# Story 25 — Knowledge Base: Authoring Workflow, Versioning, Visibility Levels and Bilingual Search (Story: 472)

## Prerequisites

- Story 24 (work item 471) completed: the Channels domain work is finished and the migration timeline ends at `database/migrations/2026_08_27_220200_fix_web_forms_foreign_keys.php`. New migrations in this story must sort **after** that file.
- Permission catalogue conventions from the Security domain are in place: `app/Domains/Security/Permissions/PermissionKey.php` (constants + `all()` at line 203) and `database/seeders/PermissionsAndRolesSeeder.php`.
- Bilingual field infrastructure exists: `app/Support/I18n/BilingualString.php` and `app/Support/I18n/Casts/BilingualStringCast.php`.
- Arabic/English normalisation precedent exists in the Customers domain: `app/Domains/Customers/Services/ArabicTextNormaliser.php` and `app/Domains/Customers/Services/TextNormaliser.php`.
- No new third-party package. **Do not** add a search engine dependency — search uses normalised SQL columns, per the acceptance criteria.

---

## Story Goal

Add a **Knowledge Base** domain (`app/Domains/Knowledge/`) that lets authors write help articles, route them through an approval workflow, publish them under a dedicated permission, version every publication, and expose them to three distinct audiences without leakage.

User-visible outcomes:

1. An article moves `draft → in_review → published → archived`; publishing requires its own permission key, separate from create/update.
2. Every publish snapshots the article into an immutable version row; versions are listable and restorable into the working draft.
3. Each article carries an explicit visibility level: `public`, `customers` (authenticated portal/registered customers), `internal` (staff only).
4. Customer-facing endpoints resolve articles through a query that is **already** constrained by audience — an `internal` article returns **404**, never 403 and never a filtered-after-fetch body, even when its UUID is known.
5. Search accepts Arabic or English input, matches against normalised columns, and applies the same audience constraint as list/show.
6. Articles hang off a browsable category tree, can be rendered into an agent reply, and accept `helpful` / `not_helpful` feedback (one vote per voter per article).

Out of scope: article attachments/file uploads, rich-text sanitising beyond plain storage, article translation workflow (both languages live in the same record via `BilingualString`), analytics dashboards, and any frontend work.

## Product rules (from story)

| Concern | Rule |
|---|---|
| Workflow | `draft` → `in_review` → `published` → `archived`. `published` → `draft` is not allowed; re-editing a published article creates/updates a draft revision, publishing it again bumps the version. `archived` may return to `draft`. |
| Publish gate | Publishing requires `knowledge.articles.publish`; creating/editing requires `knowledge.articles.create` / `knowledge.articles.update`. A user with update but not publish **cannot** move an article to `published`. |
| Versioning | Every successful publish writes an immutable version row (title, body, visibility, category, locale payload). Versions are never mutated or deleted by application code. |
| Visibility | `public` — anyone, including unauthenticated. `customers` — authenticated customer/portal identity. `internal` — staff only. |
| Enforcement | Audience narrowing happens in the **query builder** before the row is materialised. A customer-facing lookup of an internal article must not load the row at all. |
| Search | Normalised columns only; Arabic and English both hit; result set is built from the same audience-scoped base query as list/show. |
| Feedback | One vote per (article, voter identity). Re-voting flips the existing vote rather than inserting a duplicate. |

### 5 — Audience-scoped query (the security core)

**Create file:** `app/Domains/Knowledge/Services/Visibility/ArticleAudienceResolver.php`

```php
public function resolve(?Authenticatable $user, bool $isStaffContext): Audience;
```

Staff routes (`auth:sanctum` group, line 80 of `routes/api.php`) resolve to `Audience::Staff`; customer-facing routes resolve to `Audience::Customer` when an authenticated customer identity is present, otherwise `Audience::Anonymous`.

**Create file:** `app/Domains/Knowledge/Services/Visibility/ArticleQueryScope.php`

```php
public function forAudience(Audience $audience): Builder
{
    $query = KnowledgeArticle::query()
        ->whereIn('visibility', $audience->visibilityValues());

    if ($audience !== Audience::Staff) {
        $query->where('state', ArticleState::Published->value);
    }

    return $query;
}
```

**Every** customer-facing read — index, show, search, insert-into-reply, feedback — must start from `ArticleQueryScope::forAudience()`. **Do not** fetch by UUID first and check visibility afterwards; a non-matching UUID must fall out as a model-not-found → 404 through `app/Support/Http/Errors/ApiExceptionRenderer.php`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Internal article fetched by known UUID from a public route** → the row is excluded by `ArticleQueryScope::forAudience()` (task 5), so `firstOrFail()` raises model-not-found and `app/Support/Http/Errors/ApiExceptionRenderer.php` renders **404**. Never 403 — a 403 confirms the article exists.
- **Article published then switched to `internal`** → `ChangeArticleVisibility` updates the live row only; already-created version rows keep their historical visibility. A customer requesting the article afterwards gets 404 immediately.
- **Restore of a version whose category was deleted** → `knowledge_category_id` is `nullOnDelete`, so the restore lands with a null category; the article stays in `draft` and is not browsable by category until re-assigned. Enforced in `RestoreArticleVersion`.
- **User with `knowledge.articles.update` but not `knowledge.articles.publish`** attempts `POST .../state` with `published` → `KnowledgeArticlePolicy::publish` denies → 403 before the transition map is consulted.
- **Illegal transition (`published → draft`)** → `ArticleTransitionMap::canTransition` returns false → `IllegalArticleTransitionException` → 422 with the localised code.
- **Concurrent publish of the same article** → the unique composite index on `['knowledge_article_id', 'version']` (task 1) makes the second insert fail inside the transaction; the whole publish rolls back rather than producing two rows with the same version number.
- **Arabic query with Arabic-Indic digits or alef variants** → folded by `foldArabicIndic()` (`app/Domains/Customers/Services/ArabicTextNormaliser.php` line 85) on both index and query sides, so `أحمد` matches `احمد`.
- **Empty or whitespace-only search query** → `SearchArticles` returns the unfiltered audience-scoped, paginated list rather than an error, and never bypasses the audience constraint.
- **Anonymous feedback with no `visitor_key`** → reject with 422; the dedupe guarantee is impossible without an identity.
- **Repeat vote with the same value** → `DuplicateArticleFeedbackException` → 409; opposite value flips the vote and adjusts both counters in one transaction.
- **Category depth > 3** → `KnowledgeCategoryDepthExceededException`, matching the Ticketing 3-hop guard visible in `app/Domains/Ticketing/Models/TicketCategory.php` line 52.
- **Search columns drift after a direct DB edit** — accepted risk; the indexer is only invoked from Actions. Document this in a comment on `ArticleSearchIndexer` and leave a backfill command as a follow-up (out of scope here).

2. **Create** `tests/Unit/Knowledge/ArticleSearchIndexerTest.php` — Arabic alef/ta-marbuta/Arabic-Indic-digit folding and English lowercasing produce identical normalised output for equivalent inputs. Model it on `tests/Unit/Customers/PhoneNormalisationTest.php`.
3. **Create** `tests/Unit/Knowledge/ArticleQueryScopeTest.php` — for each `Audience`, assert the generated SQL constrains `visibility` and (for non-staff) `state`, and that an internal article is absent from the result of `forAudience(Audience::Anonymous)`.
4. **Create** `tests/Feature/Knowledge/KnowledgeAuthoringWorkflowTest.php` — full draft → review → publish → archive path; a user without `knowledge.articles.publish` gets 403 on publish; publish creates exactly one version row and increments `current_version`.
5. **Create** `tests/Feature/Knowledge/KnowledgeVersioningTest.php` — publish twice yields versions 1 and 2; restoring version 1 sets the article back to `draft` with version 1 content while leaving both version rows untouched.
6. **Create** `tests/Feature/Knowledge/KnowledgeVisibilityTest.php` — **the security test**. For an `internal` published article, assert `GET /api/v1/public/knowledge/articles/{uuid}` returns **404** (not 403) for anonymous and for customer audiences, and that the article does not appear in public index or public search. Repeat for a `customers`-visibility article requested anonymously.
7. **Create** `tests/Feature/Knowledge/KnowledgeSearchTest.php` — Arabic query returns the Arabic-titled article; English query returns the English-titled one; both queries executed as anonymous never return internal content.
8. **Create** `tests/Feature/Knowledge/KnowledgeFeedbackTest.php` — first vote counts, repeat identical vote → 409, opposite vote flips counters, missing identity → 422.
9. **Create** `tests/Feature/Knowledge/KnowledgeCategoryTreeTest.php` — tree shape, depth limit, and per-node counts respecting audience.
10. **Create** `database/factories/KnowledgeCategoryFactory.php`, `database/factories/KnowledgeArticleFactory.php` (with `draft()`, `published()`, `internal()` states) — follow `database/factories/TicketCategoryFactory.php` and `database/factories/WebFormFactory.php`.
11. **Extend** `tests/Feature/Api/UuidExposureTest.php` — add the new knowledge endpoints so numeric ids can never leak.
12. **Extend** `tests/Feature/Seeders/PermissionsAndRolesSeederTest.php` — the seven new permission keys exist after seeding and re-running the seeder is a no-op.
13. **Regression, no new file:** `tests/Unit/Support/NoHardcodedUserFacingStringsTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Support/MassAssignmentAuditTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Security/NoRoleNameComparisonTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Support/ApiConventionsAuditTest.php` must all stay green — they will catch a missing `ar` translation, a missing `$guarded`, a role-name comparison, or an unpaginated list.

## Migration / Rollback

- The four migrations are additive: four new tables, no column changes to existing tables. Rolling back is `down()` dropping each table in reverse FK order (`knowledge_article_feedback` → `knowledge_article_versions` → `knowledge_articles` → `knowledge_categories`).
- **Half-applied state:** if `create_knowledge_articles_table` applied but the versions table did not, `PublishArticle` fails at the version insert and its transaction rolls the article back to its prior state — no partially published article. Verify with `php artisan migrate:status` before enabling the routes.
- Permission-key changes are seeder-driven and idempotent; rolling back the code without re-seeding leaves orphan permission rows, which are inert (policies referencing them are gone).
- Route rollback: removing the `public/knowledge/*` block is safe at any time — no other domain references those endpoints.

---

## Verification Steps

All commands run inside the container, per `CLAUDE.md` line 6 (or use `make`, see `Makefile`):

1. **Migrations apply:** `docker exec -w /var/www/html/competition-crm azm-php82 php artisan migrate --force` then `php artisan migrate:status` shows all four knowledge migrations as `Ran`.
2. **Seeders idempotent:** run `php artisan db:seed` **twice**; the second run must not error and must not duplicate permission or category rows.
3. **Backend lint:** `make lint` in the project root (Pint + PHPStan per `phpstan.neon`) — zero errors.
4. **Full test suite:** `make test`.
5. **Targeted suite:** `docker exec -w /var/www/html/competition-crm azm-php82 php artisan test --filter=Knowledge`.
6. **Regression:** `docker exec -w /var/www/html/competition-crm azm-php82 php artisan test tests/Unit/Support tests/Feature/Api tests/Feature/Seeders` — envelope, pagination, UUID exposure and seeder conventions unchanged.
7. **Manual leak check:** create an `internal` published article as staff, then `curl` `GET /api/v1/public/knowledge/articles/{uuid}` with no token — must return HTTP **404** with the standard error envelope.

## Done Criteria

- [x] `knowledge_categories`, `knowledge_articles`, `knowledge_article_versions`, `knowledge_article_feedback` tables exist with UUID columns and explicit FKs.
- [x] Articles transition `draft → in_review → published → archived` through `ArticleTransitionMap`; illegal transitions return a localised 422.
- [x] Publishing is gated by `knowledge.articles.publish`, enforced in `KnowledgeArticlePolicy`, and denied (403) for a user holding only `knowledge.articles.update`.
- [x] Each publish writes exactly one immutable `KnowledgeArticleVersion`; versions are listable and restorable into a draft without mutating the version row.
- [x] Visibility is an explicit enum column and narrowing happens inside `ArticleQueryScope::forAudience()` — no post-fetch filtering anywhere in the Knowledge domain.
- [x] An `internal` article requested by UUID on any `public/knowledge/*` route returns **404**, proven by `tests/Feature/Knowledge/KnowledgeVisibilityTest.php`.
- [x] Search hits Arabic and English via `search_ar` / `search_en`, built with the existing `ArabicTextNormaliser`, and shares the audience-scoped base query.
- [x] Categories form a browsable tree limited to depth 3, with audience-correct article counts.
- [x] An agent can render an article into a reply through `POST /api/v1/knowledge/articles/render`.
- [x] Helpful / not-helpful feedback is deduplicated per voter, flips on reversal, and keeps the counters consistent under transaction.
- [x] Seven new permission keys are in `PermissionKey::all()` and seeded idempotently to roles.
- [x] Every new error code has both an `en` and an `ar` message.
- [x] `make lint && make test` pass.
